A total of 16 teams will compete in the league. The season began on 14 February 2020 and is scheduled to conclude in October 2020.{{cite web |url=http://www.thaileague.co.th/announcements-index/ประกาศ-วนเปดฤดกาล-และกำหนดการขนทะเบยนนกกฬา/ |title=ประกาศ : วันเปิดฤดูกาล และกำหนดการขึ้นทะเบียนนักกีฬา |work=thaileague.co.th |publisher=Thai League |date=19 November 2019}} The 1st transfer window is from 11 November 2019 to 3 February 2020 while the 2nd transfer window is from 15 June 2020 to 12 July 2020. [[Chiangrai United F.C.|Chiangrai United]] are the defending champions, while [[BG Pathum United F.C.|BG Pathum United]], [[Police Tero F.C.|Police Tero]] and [[Rayong F.C.|Rayong]] have entered as the promoted teams from the [[2019 Thai League 2]]. league runners-up and 3rd place qualifying for the play-offs. ==Teams== There are 16 clubs in the league, with three promoted teams from [[Thai League 2]] replacing the two teams that were relegated from the [[2019 Thai League 1|2019 season]] along with [[PTT Rayong F.C.|PTT Rayong]] who folded at the end of the campaign. All clubs that secured Thai League status for the season were subject to approval by the AFC Club Licensing before becoming eligible to participate. [[Chainat Hornbill F.C.|Chainat Hornbill]] and [[Chiangmai F.C.|Chiangmai]] were relegated at the end of the 2019 season after finishing in the bottom two places of the table. [[PTT Rayong F.C.|PTT Rayong]] withdrew from the league after the season, sparing [[Suphanburi F.C.|Suphanburi]] from relegation.{{cite web |url=http://www.foxsports.co.th/foot-ball/thai-football/181398/breaking-%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%97-%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5/ |title=BREAKING! ปตท.ยันขอพักทีมพีทีที ระยองไม่มีกำหนด พร้อมชดเชยทั้งทีมตามสัญญา |work=foxsports.co.th |publisher=Fox Sports |date=28 October 2019 |access-date=28 October 2019 |archive-date=28 October 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191028100622/https://www.foxsports.co.th/foot-ball/thai-football/181398/breaking-%e0%b8%9b%e0%b8%95%e0%b8%97-%e0%b8%a2%e0%b8%b1%e0%b8%99%e0%b8%82%e0%b8%ad%e0%b8%9e%e0%b8%b1%e0%b8%81%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b5%e0%b8%a1%e0%b8%9e%e0%b8%b5%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b5%e0%b8%97%e0%b8%b5/ |url-status=dead }}{{cite web |url=http://www.goal.com/th/ข่าว/ไมมเพลยออฟ-สมาคมยนยดกฏ-สพรรณบร-รอดตายหลงพททพกทม/zoi3ofedsc5x1vnaml1ojrufa |title=ไม่มีเพลย์ออฟ! สมาคมยันยึดกฏ สุพรรณบุรี รอดตายหลังพีทีทีพักทีม |work=goal.com |publisher=Goal Thailand |date=28 October 2019}} They were replaced by [[2019 Thai League 2]] champions [[BG Pathum United F.C.|BG Pathum United]], whom played under the name Bangkok Glass in the [[2018 Thai League 1]] campaign. They were joined by runners up [[Police Tero F.C.|Police Tero]], who also got promoted at the first time of asking and 3rd place [[Rayong F.C.|Rayong]].
